reauth_confirm.description: Your session with {hub} expired or was signed out. Sign in again to keep seeing your lists, tasks and expenses.

init.title: Compra Hub options
init.description:
**Home Assistant user:** who this hub account belongs to. With several accounts connected, voice, actions and the card use the account of whoever uses them.

**Panel:** shows the hub inside Home Assistant. If Home Assistant is not on the same domain as the hub, use the panel's «Open in a window» button.

data.panel: Show the hub in the sidebar

add_expense.name: Add an expense
add_expense.description: Adds an expense to the hub, personal or in a group.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Hub account. If omitted, the linked user's or the only one connected.

group.name: Group
group.description: Group name. Without a group, the expense is personal.

paid_by.name: Paid by
paid_by.description: Hub user who paid (group only). Defaults to you.

participants.name: Split between
participants.description: Hub users who owe their share (group only). Defaults to everyone.

plan_meal.name: Plan a meal
plan_meal.description: Puts a dish in the hub's menu.

settle_debts.description: Marks everything pending between your account and another person in a group as paid, both ways.
